name: Dell WD19S 130W USB-C Dock
source_title: Dell WD19S Docking Station User Guide and Specifications
excerpt: Dell Docking Station WD19S (Regulatory Model: K20A001). Connects via attached USB Type-C cable. Requires DisplayPort over USB Type-C host support. 1x HDMI 2.0b, 2x DisplayPort 1.4. Supports dual 4K displays at 60Hz or dual FHD displays in extended desktop mode. Powered by 130W AC adapter, delivering up to 90W Power Delivery to Dell laptops and 65W to non-Dell laptops. 3x USB 3.1 Gen 1 Type-A, 1x Gigabit Ethernet (RJ-45).
